dimensions.question: Can a first-time reader explain the loop this repository studies after twenty seconds?
Can claims be traced to the owner plan, reports, specs, or tests?
Do headings, bold anchors, and first sentences carry the story?
Are the people, robot, and loop visible without competing panels?
Does the story still work when the wide and square assets stack?

decision_rule: Accept only when evidence_safety passes and no weighted dimension is below 3/5; human review decides promotion.
